purpose: Demonstrate estimation through a financial report, plus exact servicing, graph and observation examples. No bank inference or package qualification.
estimator: Equal-target-weight difference in stratum cell means; four two-sided cellwise Student intervals with alpha/4 error each, propagated by interval arithmetic.
restrictions: Assigned offer is received and reprices all eligible balances for one year
No interference, loss to follow-up, additional capital cost or within-year balance dynamics
Known fixed target weights and accounting coefficients
stop_conditions: Any observed cell has fewer than two outcomes
Exact enumeration or matrix checks fail
CLI report differs from callable library result
budget: One seeded sample; four exact illustrations; reproducibility rerun allowed; no calibration campaign or external calls
interpretation: One interval is an illustration, not a coverage experiment. Union-bound coverage is conditional on the specified normal sampling law and cell sizes.
